title: The §4 denominator — the TurnDelta frames ablation arm, and the gen-14 frame-deletion verdict
registration: designs/research_state/gen13_endofrun_runbook.md §4; the numeric rule was fixed in the GEN-13.5 work order BEFORE this arm existed
instrument: agents.model.critic_route_audit._Arms.frames — zeroes the turn_history + prev_action_mask obs slices AT INPUT via an extractor forward_pre_hook
why_input_side: event_seats key-masks the whole seat block, so its reading is 'everything downstream of that content, gone'. Zeroing a mid-pipeline tensor would measure ONE consumer; the frames feed the history tokens AND the global token.

slices.source: build_schema(layout).slices() — never a literal; the obs moved 2669 -> 2921 -> 3529 in three generations
slices.note: 1124 matches the -1124 the gen-14 plan cites

verdict.rule: GO iff event_seats dV >= frames dV; frames within [0.8x, 1.25x] of seats => INCONCLUSIVE (escalate); frames > 1.25x seats => NO-GO
verdict.reading: The event seats carry 2.13x what the frames carry, on every measure (dV, KL, flips). Far below the inconclusive band's floor.

falsification.why: a GO here authorises deleting 1124 obs dims — retrain-class and hard to undo — so the arm was tested for dynamic range and for hitting the slices it names
checks_passed: dynamic range: a known-large ablation reads 21.88, ~16x the frames arm
no manufactured signal: a zero-width arm reads EXACTLY 0.0
independent corroboration: ablating event CONTENT at obs input (2.7395 / 35.7%) reproduces the event SEATS module arm (2.7714 / 35.1%) by a different route
the ablated slices were non-zero: turn_history 12.2% non-zero entries (|mean| 7.06), prev_action_mask 67.4%
sample stability: frames dV 1.3015 at n=6000 vs 1.3411 at n=1500

caveats: dV/KL/flips measure DEPENDENCE of the trained gen-13 forward, not what a model TRAINED without the frames would do. A route can read low because a substitute already carries the content — which is exactly the claim here, and why the seats arm is the comparator rather than zero.
Both arms are measured on gen-13, where the seats are present. This cannot say what the frames were worth in gen-12, where they were the only history route.
